content: Zustand README (pmndrs/zustand main, v5): create/set/get API with immutable updates; selectors with strict equality, useShallow for object/array picks; subscribe with subscribeWithSelector middleware; persist middleware for any storage; immer middleware for nested updates; vanilla createStore + useStore binding for store-per-context; devtools middleware; slices pattern for splitting stores (documented best practice); NO built-in undo/redo - temporal history is external. Third-party: zundo (charkour/zundo, v2, <700B) temporal middleware adds undo/redo/clear/pause/resume, partialize to exclude fields from history, limit for history depth, equality to skip unchanged snapshots, diff to store deltas, handleSet to throttle/debounce high-frequency sets (typing); requires zustand v4.2+/v5; used by Dify, Alibaba x-render, Stability AI StableStudio.
